articles.title: Zelenskyy urges US to speed up Patriot deliveries
articles.summary: Washington approved the sale of 500 interceptors, but Kyiv says deliveries may begin only years from now.

articles.title: Oleshky evacuees reunite with families after truce allows crossing back into Ukraine
articles.summary: The rescue began Friday under a local truce, with evacuees travelling through Russia and Belarus.

articles.title: Turkiye’s Erdogan urges Russia and Ukraine to stop Black Sea attacks
articles.summary: He and Zelenskyy agreed to work on a new grain corridor through the waterway.

articles.title: Iran’s Supreme Leader threatens US with response if strikes are launched after midterms
articles.summary: He reportedly told military officials to prepare an immediate response without geographic limits.

articles.title: At least four Palestinians killed in Gaza as Israeli attacks continue
articles.summary: Shelling at the Nuseirat camp killed a teacher, according to al-Awda Hospital.

articles.title: More than 290 arrested in France as some weekend protests turn violent
articles.summary: The interior ministry counted 320,000 demonstrators nationwide, including 70,000 in Paris.

articles.title: Polish president Nawrocki pushes his way into top court amid rule-of-law tussle
articles.summary: The dispute centres on the appointment of the Constitutional Tribunal's acting president.

articles.title: Starmer says UK must get closer to Europe as US relationship changes
articles.summary: The former prime minister urged European leaders to strengthen defence against Russia.

articles.title: London police arrest 139 as hundreds protest Palestine Action ban
articles.summary: The rally outside the US embassy preceded a Supreme Court hearing on the group's proscription.

articles.title: U.S. Embassy Warns of Potential 'Mass Casualty Event' in Moscow
articles.summary: The embassy named the Tsaritsyno Museum Reserve as the threatened location and said it was coordinating with Russian authorities.

articles.title: Putin’s potential G20 comeback risks normalizing Russian war crimes, says Kallas
articles.summary: The EU foreign policy chief also rebuffed reported calls for allies to soften criticism of the Kremlin.

articles.title: UN peacekeeping mission in Western Sahara to expire amid US, Russia vetoes
articles.summary: The Security Council failed to renew MINURSO after Washington and Moscow vetoed each other's draft resolutions.

articles.title: US cancels G20 ‘family photo’ after Australia, UK and others refuse to appear with Russia
articles.summary: Several delegations said they would not pose alongside Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov.

articles.title: G20 foreign ministers end Atlanta meeting without consensus on key issues
articles.summary: The meeting closed with a chair's statement instead of a joint communiqué.
